title: Publish the joined release-candidate receipt

authority.statement: This joined release-candidate receipt binds child goal identities, schema versions, validation evidence paths, and the plan §10 28 acceptance gates with command/result/artifact triples. No gate is marked pass without a present evidence artifact. This receipt does not implement subsystem behavior, does not merge PRs, and is not completion-authoritative for supervisor board status mutation.

release_decision.meaning: Release Candidate — architecture and evidence are reviewable; residual gates block production GO
rationale: Four-language structural suites baselined green; mcpp-jcs-v1 identity agrees (gate 24).
Dual MCP bindings, A2A, Profile G fence, Profile H payment≠auth, kit UCAN, datasets policy/P2P, accelerate durable/envelope cells have re-runnable commands and artifacts.
Multiple plan gates remain partial (CRDT breadth, forest-wide receipt-signed, remote CI green, full demo bundle instance).
Implementation report recommendation is RC; this joined receipt confirms RC and does not promote to GO without residual closure.
Draft PRs are unmerged; this task does not merge PRs.
conditions_to_promote_rc_to_go: Bind green GitHub Actions runs for both required workflows on release HEADs (gate 28).
Close or explicitly waive residual partial gates with command+artifact (notably 8–11, 15, 19–20, 22, 25–26 as residual).
Publish a DemoEvidenceBundle@1 instance validated by independent verifier for this HEAD (gates 25–26).
Keep no cell marked implemented without a matrix command.
Do not merge draft PRs without human review after residual closure.
why_not_go: 7 of 28 gates remain partial with residual evidence.
Remote CI green run not bound (gate 28).
Full three-peer demo evidence bundle instance not published under docs/reports (gates 25–26).
why_not_no_go: Four-language baselines and JCS identity green.
Critical security boundaries (H payment≠auth, G stale fence, kit UCAN negatives) have focused commands.
Implementation report and draft PR texts exist; user overlays preserved.

explicit_non_claims: Trees are not production-ready solely because this receipt is RC.
Profile G is not Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus.
Simulated Groth16/ZK is not Verified Execution.
Payment, PeerID, TLS client cert, or registry presence is not authorization.
This task does not merge draft PRs.
No gate is passed without evidence.

pull_requests.policy: Draft PRs only; human review required; this task does not merge.

limitations: Runtime adapter matrix still contains partial/blocked cells outside implemented commands.
Baseline broader runtime suite debt remains recorded for accelerate/datasets/kit/SwissKnife inventory selections.
Gate 28 requires remote CI green evidence not present in this receipt.
Gates 25–26 require a produced demo evidence bundle instance for full pass.
SwissKnife local conformance matrices are not forest-wide four-language admission.
